items.challenge: A multi-platform D2C operator in UAE with no clear month-end process. Books were 3 months behind. No P&L visibility.
items.outcome: Management now reviews financials every Friday. Cash position tracked in real time.
items.title: A UAE D2C Retailer Cuts Reporting Time From 18 Days to 5

items.challenge: A construction business in KSA with project-level reporting gaps. No WIP accounting. Margin bleeding invisibly.
items.outcome: Identified 3 projects losing money. Repriced 2. Exited 1. Gross margin expanded +600bps.
items.title: KSA Construction Firm Recovers AED 8.4M in Gross Margin

items.challenge: A health-tech startup preparing for seed round. Books messy. No financial model. Investors asking for data room.
items.outcome: Closed AED 5.1M seed round. Investor cited financial clarity as a key factor in decision.
items.title: Health-Tech Startup Models 18 Months of Runway Ahead of Its Seed Round

items.challenge: A logistics company in Bahrain with a 67-day cash conversion cycle. Supplier terms misaligned with receivables.
items.outcome: Cash cycle reduced to 41 days. Working capital freed up by AED 2.9M.
items.title: Bahrain Logistics Company Frees Up AED 2.9M in Working Capital

items.challenge: A consultancy in Dubai with 12 staff and no utilization tracking. Headcount growing but margins flat.
items.outcome: Identified 4 underperforming client accounts. Repriced or exited. Profit per head up 32%.
items.title: Dubai Consultancy Lifts Profit per Head by 32% With Utilization Tracking

items.challenge: An e-commerce business that had never filed VAT correctly. 2 years of messy books. UAE CT deadline approaching.
items.outcome: Fully compliant. No penalties. Clean books handed to ongoing accounting team.
items.title: UAE E-Commerce Business Reaches Full VAT Compliance in 6 Weeks
